leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a typed command interface to define undoable operations
Construct a command history manager to track executed commands
Manipulate the command stack to support undo and redo operations
Initialize application state with typed command history functionality
Apply command pattern principles to create reversible user actions
Configure undo/redo boundaries to prevent invalid state transitions
Update UI components to reflect current command history position
lessonTitle: Build typed command history undo redo
